content.value: Radix sort can be implemented using different bases such as binary (base 2), decimal (11) [CO4] (base 10), and hexadecimal (base 16). For the case of sorting 32-bit integers, determine the number of passed and the number of buckets required for each base. Compare their relative performance and state which base is the most efficient. Assume that the number of elements n ≥ 10,000.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
